notes.title: v1.3 Updates
notes.notes:
Hi, thanks for all the support!

There will be more updates to the game as we strive to make it better. Some bugs have been squashed and we're looking to add new levels and possibly a leaderboard. We've heard the feedback and that is the most asked for feature.

We will be including Steam Trading Cards and Steam Achievements in the near future.

Please check below for the changelog of v1.3
 - Fixed Bugs
 - Added Controls Screen to Main Menu & Pause Menu
 - Rewrote all Mission Texts
 - Changed button texts for consistency
 - Added Floating Text for feedback when picking up Fuel Canisters & Data Caches
 - Balanced Acceleration, Rotation & Player Damage
